# HisabPoint • Digital Bahi Khata Ledger Engine

> HisabPoint is an autonomous, real-time digital bahi khata ledger engine built for Indian merchants, kirana stores, small businesses, and retail shopkeepers.

HisabPoint simplifies customer and supplier credit management, payment tracking, zero-drift balance calculations, and multi-UPI collection without requiring traditional accounting knowledge.

## Primary Documentation & Links
- [HisabPoint Web Application](https://hisab-point.vercel.app/): Main portal for merchant accounting and ledger tracking.
- [Merchant Login](https://hisab-point.vercel.app/login): Access shopkeeper dashboard and records.
- [Merchant Registration](https://hisab-point.vercel.app/register): Create a free shop account with instant access.
- [Live Demo](https://hisab-point.vercel.app/login?demo=true): Test-drive HisabPoint with pre-filled sample store data.
- [Customer Credit & Debit Khata](https://hisab-point.vercel.app/): Track customer dues (Udhaar / Jama) and payment dates.
- [Supplier Ledger (Payables)](https://hisab-point.vercel.app/): Manage vendor purchases and payments.
- [Billing & Invoices](https://hisab-point.vercel.app/): Instant digital bills and WhatsApp receipt generation.

## Legal & Compliance
- [Privacy Policy](https://hisab-point.vercel.app/privacy): Digital Personal Data Protection (DPDP) Act compliance.
- [Terms & Conditions](https://hisab-point.vercel.app/terms): Terms of service and usage conditions.
